meta.description: Deterministic contract corpus for the raw-equality anchor primitive (services/anchors.py). Each case pins how find_all_exact_anchors must behave against a fixed document text. The write gate accepts an anchor ONLY when exactly one span is returned; every other outcome (zero, many, normalization-level miss) is an abstention. This suite proves the deterministic primitive, not any live model.
meta.expected_spans meaning: the list of [start, end) offsets find_all_exact_anchors must return; the gate 'accept' iff its length == 1
